The '''Naboo Airforce''' was an organization associated with the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] population of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. One of their bases was the [[Harte Secur Airbase]], located southwest of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Harte Secur]]. Some of the most skilled [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] on Naboo resided there.<ref name="GB" />

During the [[Invasion of Naboo]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], a reconnaissance briefing to the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|commander]] [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]] warned that the Naboo Airforce was not to be trifled with. The briefing also recommended that the [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|droid]] destroy the Harte Secur Airbase after [[Capture of Harte Secur|retrieving]] a [[droid control program]] that the Naboo had stolen.<ref name="GB" /> Several [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> from the base<ref name="GB" /> later attacked OOM-9's forces at his [[Deactivated Camp|camp]] but were destroyed by [[E4 baron droid|baron battle droids]].<ref name="Prima" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Naboo Airforce was mentioned in the reconnaissance briefing of "Behind the Lines," the second level of the Trade Federation campaign in the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''.<ref name="GB" />
